start: A saved workout's page, the workout has no photos

user_sees: Card 'Photos' with '0 of 4' and the line 'Private. They stay on this phone.'
must_not: Another workout's photos
No way to add a photo

user_sees: Sheet 'Add a photo to this workout' with 'Up to 4. Private: they stay on this phone.' and rows 'Take a photo' and 'Choose from gallery'
must_not: The camera opening without a choice

steps.action: Tap 'Take a photo' and take one
user_sees: The button reads 'Adding…' then the photo appears as a square; the count says '1 of 4'
must_not: Two copies of the photo
The photo saved on another workout

steps.action: Tap the photo, pinch to zoom, then tap the close button
user_sees: Full screen 'Workout photo'; it zooms up to 5 times and cannot be dragged off the screen; 'Remove photo' under it
must_not: The photo dragged fully off the screen
The page behind changed by the pinch

start: A saved workout's page, one photo

steps.action: Tap 'Add photo', then 'Choose from gallery', pick a picture
must_not: The gallery picture moved or deleted from the gallery
No message when the pick fails

user_sees: The page as before, no message
must_not: An error message for a cancel

start: Finishing a workout: the 'Workout complete' summary; and Edit workout of a saved one

steps.action: On 'Workout complete', tap 'Add photo' and take a photo
user_sees: The same Photos card; the photo saved straight away on the just-saved workout
must_not: The photo lost when the summary is closed

steps.action: Later, open the workout, tap More, 'Edit workout', and look at Photos
user_sees: The same photo, and the same Add photo and remove controls
must_not: The photo missing in the edit
Leaving the edit with Discard deleting the photo without saying

steps.action: Tap 'Take a photo' and refuse the camera permission
user_sees: A plain line in red about the camera and a button 'Open settings'
must_not: A crash or a blank square
The ask returning on every tap with no way out

steps.action: With 4 photos on the workout, look at the card
user_sees: '4 of 4' and the line '4 of 4 photos. Remove one to add another.'; no Add photo button
must_not: A fifth photo added

steps.action: Add a photo while the workout is deleted on another screen
user_sees: 'This workout was deleted, so the photo wasn’t added.'
must_not: A photo kept for a workout that no longer exists

start: Saved workout page with two photos

steps.action: Tap the round X on the first photo
user_sees: Question 'Remove this photo?' with 'It is deleted from this workout and from the app for good.' and 'Remove'
must_not: The photo removed without asking
A photo removed after Cancel

steps.action: Open the second photo full screen, tap 'Remove photo', then 'Remove'
user_sees: Full screen closes; one photo left; '1 of 4'; Add photo shown
must_not: The removed photo coming back on the next visit
The other photo removed

start: Saved workout page with photos; the member has a MettleUp cloud copy

must_not: The photos visible to the gym, a trainer or a gym mate

user_sees: The workout reaches the cloud copy without its photos (cloud snapshot leaves workout_photos out)
must_not: Workout photos uploaded to the cloud copy
Photos in a share picture without the member choosing them

steps.action: Save a backup file from Settings, Back up and restore
user_sees: The backup file is the member's own file; it holds the photos as the What's new line says
must_not: Photos sent anywhere the member did not choose
